axes.concept: Bastidor: a saved installation is brought back onto its physical frame, with balloon clusters, Backing and a rectangular table. Projects are scenes to resume rather than dashboard statistics.
axes.layout: A broad front-elevation stage and a narrower project caption form a 1.6:1 composition; a four-thumbnail ribbon sits below. Below 768px the stage, caption and two-column ribbon stack. Editor has a 280px summary; import uses a 1.3:1 consent spread.
axes.navigation: Choose projects directly in the thumbnail ribbon or with labelled previous/next buttons; the selected title and Continue action stay beside the stage. The header returns to Projects. There is no sidebar, floating dock, drag dependency or tool-station rail. Native preview and language selectors remain visible.
axes.typography: Shared system sans: 30px collection title, 34px light-weight selected project title, 24px editor title, 22px dialog title and 14–15px working text. Metadata is 12–13px. Project titles wrap freely on phone; no display face or decorative KPI numerals.
axes.density: One selected project receives a 325px stage and 40px separation from its caption. Desktop structure uses 24px outer padding, phone 20px. Dialogs have 28/24px padding and controls are at least 44px tall. Four thumbnail objects form a compact ribbon rather than equal information cards.
axes.components: Installed shadcn/Base UI Button, Input and Skeleton; shadcn Dialog/AlertDialog roots and titles with real Animate UI Portal/Backdrop/Popup composed locally to pass profile-aware enter/exit transitions. Custom SVG installation, stage, thumbnail ribbon, scene summary and native filters. No stand-in HTML fallback.
axes.colour: Existing Pictures roles: light #faf9fc/#ffffff/#1c1425 and primary #6d3fe0; dark #0b0c10/#16181f/#f4f5f7 and primary #9479ff with #120b24 text. Controls use readable project text tokens #766c85/#8a91a0 as edges. Lavender/pink in the scene represent materials; green/amber/red carry written save/recovery status.
axes.motion: Spatial spring brings the selected stage 39.6px sideways with -5deg perspective rotation and .98 scale in expressive mode; its rig registers 30px/3deg over 832ms, balloon cluster drops 24px/7deg over 936ms, and table settles 18px over 650ms. Ribbon enters with 45ms offsets and lifts 5px on hover. Controls use 200ms; dialogs use the profile ease (420/220/140ms). Reduced motion and still=1 remove travel and use zero-duration modal backdrop/popup transitions; CSS pauses on hidden tabs.
